summary.headline: Lunar Elections and Practical Astrology
summary.text: Florentine codex entries on lunar astrology for arts, agriculture, slaves, sailing, journeys, marriage, rulers, active hours, dreams, favors, choices, letters, loans, surety, travel, conversations, outcomes, teaching, and freeing. Several entries are cross-referenced to Hephaestion of Thebes, Book III, chapters 20–30, or codex 12.
